user.description: Pick the scale (it only shows up while someone stands on it) or type its Bluetooth address.

credentials.description: Scale {address}. Enter the Tuya local_key (12 hex digits for local_key[:6], or the key text itself) and device_id. The uuid is filled in from the advertisement; leave it empty to derive it on the next weigh-in.

reauth_confirm.title: Scale rejected the local_key
reauth_confirm.description: Scale {address} could not decrypt with the stored local_key. It changes whenever the scale is re-paired in the Tuya app; re-extract it and enter it here.

error.invalid_local_key: Enter 12 hex digits or at least 6 characters of the key.
error.invalid_uuid: uuid must be ASCII letters and digits.
error.ids_too_long: uuid + device_id are too long for the pairing request.

abort.not_supported: This device does not look like a Tuya BLE scale.
